description: Image Description: The image depicts a bathroom interior. On the left side, there is a bathtub with a white tiled surround, featuring a pattern of diamond-shaped tiles near the top. Above the bathtub, a shower fixture is visible. Adjacent to the bathtub is a double-sink vanity with a light-colored countertop and wooden cabinets below. Both sinks have a chrome faucet.
